ShapeEngine
Table of Contents

Namespace ShapeEngine.Pathfinding

Classes

Path

Represents a path used by the pathfinding system. Contains the start and end positions and the sequence of rectangles that form the path. Instances are intended to be rented from and returned to an internal pool using RentPath(Vector2, Vector2, int) and ReturnPath(Path) to minimize allocations.

PathRequest

Represents a request for a path from an agent, including start/end positions and priority.

Pathfinder

A grid based pathfinder that uses A* to find paths for agents.

Structs

NodeCost

Represents a cost that can be applied to a node, affecting its traversability or weight.

Interfaces

IPathfinderAgent

Interface for agents that can request and receive paths from a Pathfinder.

IPathfinderObstacle

Represents an obstacle in the pathfinding system. Inherits from IShape.
